title: Law to raise penalties for unsafe e-bike batteries
summary: This bill would ban storing, handling, using or possessing powered bicycles, mobility devices or batteries that do not meet the city's safety standards, with civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation. It would also make selling, leasing or renting such unsafe equipment a misdemeanor punishable by up to a year in jail, in addition to civil fines. Assembling or selling repurposed (second-use) lithium-ion batteries would carry the same penalties.
